stem: Trapezoid \(KLMN\) is reflected over the \(x\)-axis to form trapezoid \(WXYZ\). Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The area of trapezoid \(KLMN\) is greater than the area of trapezoid \(WXYZ\).

options.label: B
options.text: The angle measures of trapezoid \(KLMN\) are less than the corresponding angle measures of trapezoid \(WXYZ\).

options.label: C
options.text: The sum of the angle measures of trapezoid \(KLMN\) is twice the sum of the angle measures of trapezoid \(WXYZ\).

options.label: D
options.text: The side lengths of trapezoid \(KLMN\) are congruent to the corresponding side lengths of trapezoid \(WXYZ\).
